title: Monad bills the gas limit
lesson: A transaction pays gas_limit times price. The price does not fall below 100 gwei. Unused gas is not refunded. A revert pays the whole limit. A quote that ignores the limit is not a profit.

title: Eight v2 factories
lesson: 39,296 pairs were read. 35,000 were solvent, meaning both token balances covered the reserves. A hit was a WMON-to-WMON cycle quoting more than 0.005 MON. There were two hits and zero skims above 0.02 MON or 0.02 USDC.

Gross 0.054420185 MON. minOut at the quote reverts INSUFFICIENT_OUTPUT_AMOUNT. minOut at the received amount is accepted. With no access list, eth_estimateGas is 523,536, bill 0.052353600 MON, net +0.002066585 MON, with 20,665 gas of room. With the node access list of 12 entries, eth_estimateGas is 294,130, bill 0.029413000 MON, net +0.025007185 MON, with 250,071 gas of room. An eth_call one gas under 291,725 fails. The same list on an Ethereum-schedule fork used 290,584 gas against 518,184 with no list. A revert at 294,130 costs 0.029413 MON, more than the net. Fork block 113785475 for the balance. Live block 113787261 for the gas, base fee 100 gwei. Not broadcast. v3 quotes of 1 MON: WETH +0.003455, AUSD +0.008570, USDC -0.001325, USDT -0.002571, WBTC -0.144079. None of those clears a two-leg v3 bill of about 0.028 MON.

title: What the desk still does
lesson: A quote is not a send. The signer sends when the settled gain is larger than the limit on the transaction, after eth_call, because a revert bills that limit. Clip gas stays 420,000. Rough gas on the spread desk stays half a million gas at 100 gwei. The signing wallet keeps 5 MON. Rounds stay ten minutes apart. A round sends at most 20 clips. There is no promised rate.
